node.label: SEBI & capital markets
node.summary: SEBI regulation, AIFs, FPIs, mutual funds and IPOs.

facts.text: **SEBI** was set up in **1988** and got statutory powers under the **SEBI Act, 1992**; HQ **Mumbai**.
facts.plain: SEBI was set up in 1988 and got statutory powers under the SEBI Act, 1992; HQ Mumbai.

facts.text: SC (Bench led by Justice **B.V. Nagarathna**) refused to order **SEBI** to make **AIFs** and **FPIs** publicly disclose ultimate beneficial owners without a legal framework, on MP **Mahua Moitra's** plea. Registered AIFs grew from **42 (2013) to 1,528 (2025)**; FPI assets under custody exceed **₹74 lakh crore**, vs mutual fund AUM of about **₹68 lakh crore**.
